caption: Lightning jumps between two clouds high over a plain, lighting both from inside, with no bolt reaching the ground.

sa.check: Two clouds high over a plain.
Lightning flashes between the clouds, lighting both from inside.
The plain below is flat open land.
The two clouds are separate, with the flash spanning the gap or lighting both.

pc.expect: The flash is brief; both clouds return to dark; flashes may repeat but each ends.
pc.fail: The clouds stay lit for the rest of the clip; or the glow brightens steadily; or the sky turns to daylight; or the flash fades in slowly.

pc.expect: The two clouds and the plain are the same across dark and lit frames: the same cloud shapes and the same ground features.
pc.fail: A cloud appears or vanishes between frames; or the cloud shapes change abruptly at the flash; or features on the plain appear or vanish; or a third cloud appears already lit.

pc.expect: The light comes from within and between the clouds: their bodies and edges glow with their texture revealed, and the plain brightens only faintly as a glow from above.
pc.fail: The plain lights up brightly while the clouds stay dark; or the glow is a flat wash over the frame with no cloud structure; or a spot on the ground lights up as if struck while no bolt reaches it.

pc.expect: The clouds drift only slowly; the plain and anything on it stay still through the flash.
pc.fail: The clouds jump or swirl at the flash; or objects on the plain shift at the flash; or the horizon tilts at the flash.

pc.expect: Clouds stay cloud and the plain stays ground; nothing on the ground is struck or changed.
pc.fail: A cloud turns into a solid object; or a bolt strikes the plain and leaves a glowing mark; or the ground splits or heaves; or the plain turns into water or sky.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sky's night colour and the plain's colour are consistent before and after the flash.
pc.fail: The sky changes colour permanently after the flash; or the plain changes colour; or the clouds change colour when not lit.
